name: Prophet Called By God
overview: Scripture reveals that a prophet is one whom the LORD calls and to whom He reveals His words, often through visions or dreams, as seen in Numbers 12:6. God places His words in the prophet's mouth, commissioning them to speak only what He commands, exemplified in Deuteronomy 18:18 and Jeremiah 1:9. The authority of a true prophet is confirmed by the fulfillment of their words, and any who speak presumptuously or in the name of other gods face severe judgment (Deuteronomy 18:20, 18:22). Furthermore, God discloses His plans exclusively to His servants, the prophets, underscoring their unique role as His revealed messengers (Amos 3:7).
